name: avista-wpgb-trp-fix
description: Diagnose and fix the recurring bug where WP Grid Builder facets and pagination return the default language on TranslatePress sites — root cause is WPGB's AJAX response never passing through TRP's dynamic-content translator. Ships a transport-aware filter pair (query-var AJAX + REST insurance) that translates WPGB responses for the referer's language.
